summary: The diff implements all five requirements substantially. REQ-1 (8 service cards with water-waves scroll animation via IntersectionObserver and staggered delay) is implemented in ServiceCardWithExpansion.tsx and Home.tsx. REQ-2 (inline expansion on card click, no navigation) is implemented via the expandedCategory state in Home.tsx and ExpandedServicePanel.tsx. REQ-3 (complete pricing data in services.ts) is present with the full data structure including subcategoryGroups, addOnOptions, and serviceVisitCharge fields. REQ-4 (sq.ft calculator for Commercial/Construction pest control) is implemented in PricingCalculator.tsx and wired into ExpandedServicePanel.tsx. REQ-5 (add-on options with toggleable chips and WhatsApp message inclusion) is implemented in AddOnOptions.tsx and integrated through ExpandedServicePanel.tsx and whatsappHelper.ts. Minor concerns exist around truncated diffs making full verification of all pricing values impossible, but the structure and key values visible are consistent with requirements.

missing_requirements.requirement: All 8 service categories have complete and accurate pricing data in services.ts — the truncated diff prevents full verification of Deep Cleaning, Painting, Electrical, Plumbing, Carpentry, AC Services, and Appliances Repair pricing entries.
missing_requirements.reason: The services.ts diff is truncated after showing only part of the pestControl entry. While the data structure and several prices are confirmed, the full pricing for 7 of 8 services cannot be verified from the truncated content.

hallucinated_features.description: BookingFormPopup modal integrated inside the expanded service panel on the Home page
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request specifies only Book Now and WhatsApp buttons within the expanded card panel. ExpandedServicePanel.tsx imports and uses BookingFormPopup which introduces a separate booking form popup not specified for the Home page inline expansion.
